meta_description:
2,053 likes, 22 comments - unicef on October 31, 2026: "At a nutrition centre in Sudan, Samah gives her young daughter Sidra ready-to-use therapeutic food (RUTF), an energy-dense nutrient paste used to treat malnutrition.

Conflict, displacement, worsening food insecurity and economic hardships continue to drive a severe nutrition crisis across Sudan. 

UNICEF supports partners and nutrition centres like these, including in the hardest hit areas, to provide nutrition and health services to children and mothers.

What children in Sudan need the most is peace and access to the life-saving services they need.

© UNICEF/Elfatih".
